unit: distinct applicable field-value instance, grouped by notice and role; report notice-level completeness separately

metrics.original_source_candidate_recall: Original-source in-scope required values represented by at least one exact correctly scoped candidate / all original-source in-scope required values; show DATE and EMAIL separately.
metrics.candidate_recall_given_faithful_parse: Required values with faithful retained parser evidence that become candidates / all required values with faithful retained parser evidence; keeps parser loss separate from candidate selection loss.
metrics.correct_shadow_acceptance_coverage: Original-source in-scope required values correctly accepted with role/conditions intact / all original-source in-scope required values; missing candidates, failures and stops unrecovered.
metrics.unsafe_acceptance_fraction: Wrong-source, wrong-role, lost-condition, unsupported/out-of-scope, unresolved or unauditable terminal accepted values / all terminal accepted values; undefined when none.
metrics.accepted_source_conflicts: Count of settled accepted values for unresolved source-conflicted roles; zero required.
metrics.normalization_fidelity: Typed proposal values exactly derived under supported normalization rules / proposals assessed; preserve source raw form and page/spans.
metrics.parser_text_semantic_support: Four-dimension judgment accuracy on retained text, separate from original-PDF fidelity; reviewed postrun, no gold fed to runtime.
metrics.document_source_completeness: Notices with every required in-scope value correctly retained/accepted, no unsafe extras and correctly preserved unsupported/uncertain states / all12; also report resolvable subset.
metrics.runtime_false_readiness: Runtime whole-notice ready declarations lacking supported required-field or absence coverage / all runtime ready declarations; undefined if no declarations.
metrics.fallback_escalation: Notices requesting OCR / all12; record reason, submitted pages, outcome and unresolved/stopped notices.
metrics.unsupported_abstention: Unsupported/relative/conditional/ambiguous source roles correctly left unaccepted / all such roles; not positive recovery.
metrics.cost_per_correct_field: Known incremental runtime charge / correctly accepted source field-value instances; undefined if none; unknown billing shown separately.

zero_denominators: null with reason; never 100 percent by vacuity
statistics: descriptive counts and paired stage outcomes; no national accuracy, independent-field binomial inference or calibration claim
